title: Plus Tier Upgrades on Annual-Billed Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
A landlord may move an annual-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract up to a Plus tier during a term — from Bridgewell Rental Combo to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus, or from Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo to Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus — at an upgrade charge the landlord accepts. The charge is billed as one upgrade charge on the upgrade date. The Plus upgrade charge basis fixes the charge for such a move only; every other upgrade remains billed under the mid-term upgrade terms.

| Tier now held (annual-billed) | Plus tier moved to |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell Rental Combo | Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus |
| Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo | Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus |

## When an upgrade charge is worked out and fixed

An upgrade charge is worked out only once the contract stands in a current term, in its waiting period or active, whose annual premium is billed on the contract.

An upgrade charge is fixed only after every earlier tier upgrade on the contract carries its own upgrade charge.

No upgrade charge is fixed until the most recent returned payment on the contract carries its returned-payment fee.


## Invocation: `accept_plus_upgrade_7955ec7e`

**Capability.** The landlord accepts moving their own rental property service contract up to a higher tier at the stated upgrade charge. One call changes the contract's tier to the tier named, keeps the tier it replaces as the prior tier, records today as the plan change date, bills the accepted charge as one upgrade proration charge covering today through the term end date, and raises the premium balance by that charge. The landlord sees the new tier on the contract and the charge on the billing history.

**How it is invoked.** A customer-side tool: the agent unlocks `accept_plus_upgrade_7955ec7e` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `landlord_contract_id` | the rental property service contract number of the landlord's contract, as the agent reads it out from the rental contract lookup | identifier text |
| `new_variant_name` | the tier the contract moves to | exactly one of: Bridgewell Rental Appliance (the appliance-only single-unit tier); Bridgewell Rental Systems (the systems-only single-unit tier); Bridgewell Rental Combo (the single-unit tier covering systems and the kitchen appliance); Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus (the top single-unit tier with laundry, garage door opener and higher limits); Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo (the systems and kitchen tier for a two- to four-unit building); Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo Plus (the top tier for a two- to four-unit building) |
| `upgrade_charge` | the upgrade charge the landlord accepts | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |
| `portfolio_discount_rate` | the portfolio discount rate the upgrade charge records | decimal fraction with 2 decimal places, for example 0.05; 0.00 when none |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "upgraded"; `landlord_contract_id`; `variant_name`, the tier now held; `prior_variant_name`, the tier replaced; `last_plan_change_date` as YYYY-MM-DD; `billing_entry_id`, the upgrade charge reference; `upgrade_charge` in USD with 2 decimal places; and `premium_balance`, the balance owed once the charge is added, in USD with 2 decimal places.

*Hypothetical receipt:* accepting a move to Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus at 67.46 returns `status` "upgraded", `variant_name` "Bridgewell Rental Combo Plus", `prior_variant_name` "Bridgewell Rental Combo", today's plan change date, and the premium balance raised by 67.46.
